messages.subject: Tempest - amended facility agreement signature pages
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Please find the executed signature pages for the amended facility agreement on Project Tempest. Could you confirm the conditions precedent checklist is now fully satisfied so we can date the documents?

Apologies - I think I may have the wrong James; if this isn't your matter please disregard and let me know.

Gavin Ross
Director, Restructuring & Recoveries
Sterling Commercial Bank plc
